About the role Azumo is hiring a Sales Executive to originate new AI and ML services engagements with enterprise and mid-market companies across the US and Canada.

A track record of originating new logo business, not only expanding existing accounts Working fluency in AI and ML sufficient to hold a substantive first call with a technical buyer.

Holidays USD Remuneration Profit Sharing Maternity Coverage 100% Remote Compensation and location Remote within the United States. Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes base salary plus commission. About Azumo Azumo is a software engineering partner for the era of AI.

Summary SafetyChain Software is looking for a Senior Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Sales team.This is a senior/tenured position within our BDR team.

We're building a team that operates at the cutting edge, our BDRs are expected to actively use AI tools to research accounts, build better outreach, and find creative ways to generate pipeline faster. If you've figured out how to use AI to work smarter and do more, you'll fit right in here.

Our impressive client base includes renowned brands like Albertsons, Clif Bar, Tyson Foods, and Whole Foods.

Join a dynamic, collaborative team driven by innovation, agility, and rapid growth. We are a remote-first company. While this role is primarily remote, there may be occasional opportunities to collaborate in person for quarterly business reviews, team training, or customer visits.
